methodology.generation: Distinct random 3-variable clauses with signs sampled uniformly conditional on one planted solution; clauses shuffled before assigning weights. Planted solution never passed to search.
methodology.budget: Each run has an upper cap of 1025 full-assignment evaluations. Every evaluated assignment checks all 68 clauses. Strict greedy stops early at a trap; unused budget is not recycled into restarts.
methodology.uniform: Strict best-improvement greedy over all n one-bit neighbors; random ties.
methodology.zeta: w_j=1+(0.6/K)*sum_k cos(gamma_k*log(p_j)+phase_k). gamma are first K zeta zero ordinates; p_j are consecutive primes.
methodology.shuffled_controls: An independent random permutation of exactly the same weight multiset as its structured method.
methodology.walksat: Choose a random unsatisfied clause, evaluate all 3 variable flips, choose a zero-break flip if available; otherwise with probability 0.5 choose random, else minimum break count. Random ties. Counts full clause scans for every candidate.
methodology.ties_and_stopping: Independent seeded Python RNG for each instance/start/method. Strict improvement tolerance 1e-12; exact Boolean clause satisfaction determines success.
methodology.interpretation: Small planted satisfiable distribution, no runtime timing or asymptotic inference. The baseline can make many more flips because it evaluates only 3 candidate neighbors at a time. RH is an optional global interpretation; computing the finite ordinates needs no RH assumption.
methodology.demo_selection: Four-variable examples were deliberately selected to exhibit both success and failure of fixed reweighting; they are illustrative, not benchmark evidence.

tests: Vectorized evaluator equals independent direct Boolean evaluator on 256 sampled 16-variable assignments.
Every four-variable demonstration examined exhaustively preserves exact SAT zero sets for all six weights.
Every retained path consists only of one-bit moves; every reported success independently checks all clauses.
All runs respect the common assignment-evaluation cap.
